    What this page shows

    Each request, its reference, the pieces it contains and the date it was made. Requests are stored under aura_order_requests_v1 in this browser only.

    Why there is no password

    A server account needs identity, security and data retention behind it. Until that exists, the browser is the honest place to keep this list. Clearing site data clears the list; the invoice sent to you by email remains valid.

    This is a local record, not an order history and not proof of purchase.
